responsibility: Declares the Rust AST type-resolution subsystem. It provides visitors and helpers for resolving ordinary and qualified type paths, trait bounds, generic parameters, where clauses, generic argument disambiguation, and conversion of types into canonical paths, making this header the central interface through which the rest of the resolver handles type namespaces and type-related AST subtrees.
same_name_distinction: Declares the type-resolution subsystem’s classes and entry points—ResolveType, relative path resolvers, bound/where-clause helpers, generic-parameter and generic-argument resolvers, and canonical-path conversion helpers. Unlike the matching .cc file, it organizes the API and some small inline visitors rather than the full type-resolution implementations.
